notes.title: New Game Announcement and 3rd Anniversary Celebration
notes.notes:
This month marks the 3rd anniversary of the establishment of "Barance Studio" and the 2nd anniversary of the release of our team's first title, "Robolife" We would like to express our sincere gratitude to the players who have been guiding and supporting us throughout this journey. As a token of appreciation, we would like to share a artwork of "Robolife Series" by our artist, SIUPONG. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39199244/019a73851bfb7932eb1bcd690ad45292723b779b.jpg[/img]
In the days to come, I hope that our team's new releases will bring joy and sexy experiences to all of you. This has always been the vision of our team and a personal goal of mine. Additionally, we will be participating in the Summer Sale in 14 hours, offering a 25% discount on “Robolife1" and a 15% discount on "Robolife2"! Furthermore, we are excited to announce that our next project, " X-Angels," will be completed in the second quarter of next year.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2090810
Unlike our previous game themes, this time we are attempting to combine elements of "Pure Love" and "Punishing Heroes" in the game content. It presents a significant challenge for us, the "Pure Love Warriors", but since the theme is "Defeating Superheroes," it would be a shame not to push the boundaries a bit! Of course, the majority of the content will still focus on pure love, and we will also implement a "Skip Inappropriate Content" system to cater to vanilla taste players. We kindly ask you to add " X-Angels" to your wishlist and stay tuned for updates! Thank you very much!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39199244/cfb0becc95fd82d29fd8141c2d3ef7ff59192ec5.png[/img]

◇ Gameplay
Choose the Angel you want to defeat and build the strongest deck in a limited timeframe before you face off with her in a final battle!

◇ Rogue-lite Deck-Building
Defeat the Angels and use their powers to put together a killer deck!

◇ To Love or to Corrupt?
Your choices affect what happens to each defeated Angel! Will you tug at their heartstrings, or will you break their minds and bodies?

◇ Most Importantly...
X-Angels features fully-voiced 34 H-Events and 26 Animated CGs.

◇System—
Difficulty adjust
Skip Inappropriate Content
4 main heroine can be date with freedomly

notes.title: New game announcement: RoboLife-Days with Aino
notes.notes:
[u][b]Warning: this is a NSFW game announcement, make sure you are adult to see this post
[/b][/u]

Hi, this is Angus Huang: producer & team leader for Barance Games
Development on RoboLife-Days with Aino is moving at a brisk pace.
We should be ready to release the game by summer of this year.

As a new team, we chose to develop this as a visual novel with management mechanics. Allow me to put a introduction below.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38386317/1bc84d8adfdfba376f42a154ec59a9d215e2a4e7.jpg[/img][/url]
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1477810/RoboLifeDays_with_Aino/]To see gameplay and game feature. Click the link here[/url][/b]




[u][b]Story Intro[/b][/u]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38386317/68b1ed417ae325e258e0cba3706cd3ae7940696e.jpg[/img]
This is a romantic comedy about a robot girl's journey of self-discovery.
In order to graduate from Ahroy Academy, famed for its prowess in AI, I need to program and train an android to function seamlessly in society.
But...

“Orders received, eliminating target.”

Aino, an android I dragged back from the dump, lunged at me with a blade the moment she opened her eyes. If she hadn't experienced a system error, I would've died a virgin! After learning about her inaccessible black box, and her inability to recall her past, I saw an opportunity for cooperation.

“This place is pretty run down, but Aino accepts your proposal.”
“Thanks for putting it delicately. Are you really an android?”

I'll help her uncover her past, and in exchange, she'll help me graduate!
We'll be living together as man and android, in an exciting, chaotic, heart-pounding cohabitation arrangement!
Like I said, it's a romantic comedy about a robot girl's journey of self-discovery!


For more information, we have store page for RoboLife.
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1477810/RoboLifeDays_with_Aino/]To see gameplay and game feature. Click the link here[/url][/b]
